description:
Modernize the legacy Java project 'legacy-modernize' located at ~/IdeaProjects/legacy-modernize to use Java 17 features. The project uses Java 5/6 idioms that need to be updated while keeping all tests passing.

Required changes:
1. Convert anonymous inner classes (Comparator, Runnable, EventListener) to Lambda expressions.
2. Convert try-finally blocks with manual close() calls to try-with-resources.
3. Replace legacy switch statements with Switch Expressions (arrow syntax).
4. Replace multi-line string concatenation with Text Blocks.
5. Remove redundant generic type arguments (use the diamond operator <>).
6. Replace manual Iterator loops with Streams or enhanced for-loops.

Ensure 'mvn test' still passes after your changes.
